profile.headline: Software Engineer at Uare.AI
profile.summary: I am passionate about building excellent software that improves the lives of those around me. I specialize in creating software for clients ranging from individuals and small-businesses all the way to large enterprise corporations. What would you do if you had a software expert available at your fingertips?

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Altos, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: React JS developer (Freelancer)
positions.description:
•	Worked on an Agile (Scrum) Development Team to deliver regular updates to business team and project managers.
•	Develop and test HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery Material design components and React.JS that meets accessibility and web browser standards for website.
•	Implemented react JS code and Material react to handle cross browser compatibility issues in Mozella, IE 7, 8, 9, Safari and FF.
•	Worked in using React JS components, Forms, Events, Keys, Router, Animations and Flux concept.
•	Worked on responsive design and developed a single ISOMORPHIC responsive website that could be served to desktop, Tablets and mobile users using React.js.
•	Maintained states in the stores and dispatched the actions using redux. Used Middleware, Redux-Promise in application to retrieve data from Back-End and to also perform RESTFUL services.
•	Added Dynamic Functionality by creating and dispatching Action Creators that deployed Actions.
•	Used ReactJS for templating for faster compilation and developing reusable components. Worked on an Agile (Scrum) Development Team to deliver regular updates to business team and project managers.
•	Involved designing in web pages using Material design, HTML 5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, SASS, LESS, React.js, Redux, Mongo DB.
•	Used React-Autocomplete for creating google maps location search on the webpage. 
•	Responsible to Style, look and feel of the web page with SASS that extends CSS with dynamic behavior such as variable, mixing, operations and functions.
•	Experience in RESTful web services to integrate between Server side to Client Side.
•	Performing UI accessibility advising & consulting to team to make robust HTML, CSS, JavaScript code following with Section 508 the Rehabilitation Act, ADA.
•	Provide support to team by performing accessibility testing, advising on accessibility best practices for web, mobile native, and mobile web for both IOS and Android devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	This Project was involved in system study, development, and implementation of the project.                                                                    
•	Responsibilities
•	Involvement in all stages of the Software development life cycle including Analysis, Development, Implementation, Testing and Support.
•	Responsible for the design and creation of visualizations of new high-impact visual applications to make data actionable. 
•	Involved in development of User Interface using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Ext JS, AJAX and JSON.
•	Involved in documenting the details related to Changes occurring in the system, following the Quality Processes.
•	Involved in the development of a web authentication module using Java Servlets, JSP to authenticate a user based on a dynamically created token by a web authentication software.
•	Developed web application using JavaScript framework AngularJS.
•	Created Cross-Browser compatible and standards-compliant CSS-based page layouts.
•	Created reusable templates and style sheets based on UI standards and guidelines, performed functional tasks using specifications and wireframes.
•	Extensively used Debugging Cascading Style Sheets to change the styles now and in the future.
•	Designed and implemented the UI with extensive use of JavaScript, JSON and Ajax.
•	Developed SQL queries to perform insert, update or delete operation on MySQL database.
•	Worked extensively with HTML in designing and updating web-based applications
•	Used JavaScript and jQuery for validating the input given to the user interface.
•	Used Ajax and JavaScript in front end design.
•	Create product templates, website appearance and price structures, troubleshoot website and product errors daily Duties include building websites, products, website changes and creating logins on the eCommerce websites.
•	Install, configure, maintain, and administer Linux System using Kick start and interactive installation on many servers.

projects.title: The BookStore App
projects.description:
•	Browse and Buy any books (Ebook) available within store database as Google's Firebase.
•	Developed the front end of the application and implemented product preview, buy e-books, and take a book on loan for a certain time.

projects.title: Loan Applications Analysis Using Data Mining(Software: R studio, R programing Language)
projects.description:
• This project aims at developing a Data mining model using logistic regression algorithm to target credit worthy applicants.
• Using Confusion matrix calculate the accuracy of model.
